description: This file contains API utility functions for a frontend dashboard, including methods to resolve API base URLs, fetch module overviews, and retrieve overview metrics, with internal helper functions for HTTP requests and data normalization.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Performs a fetch request and returns JSON or text payload, throwing an error on non-OK responses.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a modules overview for the dashboard, attempting multiple endpoints or deriving minimal data.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total metrics for the overview screen.
